description: Runs your own ComfyUI workflow, on one or more ComfyUI servers: generates audio for each segment, and also transcribes, aligns and compares voices. Add the workflow to the project's assets (exported with Export (API)); its {{tags}} become the speaker's settings.

workerSettings.label: Servers
workerSettings.placeholder: cloud.comfy.org (or enter local ComfyUI instance IP, e.g. 127.0.0.1:8188)
workerSettings.description: ComfyUI addresses (host:port), one per line, such as 127.0.0.1:8188. Left empty, Comfy Cloud (cloud.comfy.org) is used, which needs the API key below. With Parallel workers above 1, the workers take turns over the servers (worker 1 the first server, worker 2 the second, and so on).

workerSettings.label: Comfy Cloud API key
workerSettings.description: Only for Comfy Cloud (cloud.comfy.org, needs a paid plan). Create a key at platform.comfy.org under Profile > API Keys. It is saved in this machine's settings, in plain text.

workerSettings.label: Timeout (s)
workerSettings.description: How long to wait for one generation on a server, including time in ComfyUI's queue.

settings.label: Workflow
settings.description: A ComfyUI workflow from the project's assets (exported with Workflow > Export (API)). Its {{tags}} appear below as settings; {{text}}, {{seed}} and {{duration}} are filled in from the segment. A Seed setting appears when the workflow has something to seed.
